title: The Exam Night Disaster
custom_script:
# Scene: bedroom (sitting, books)
Peddy: {aah} Teddy! The *exam* is TOMORROW and I know nothing! [surprised, wave, shout, scream]
Teddy: {hmm} Relax. We have the whole *night*. [normal, idle, calm]
Peddy: {read} Okay… chapter one. {turn-page} {uff} Why are there so many *pages*? [sad, think]
Teddy: {phone} Just five minutes on my *phone*. Then we study. [happy, shrug, whisper]
Peddy: {haan} Five minutes? You said that an *hour* ago! [angry, point, shout, boing]
# Time skip: Three hours later…
# Scene: bedroom (sitting, phones)
Teddy: {giggle} Look, a *cat* playing piano! {laugh} [happy, point, excited]
Peddy: {wow} So cute! {gasp} Wait… what *time* is it? [surprised, wave, gasp]
Teddy: {look-around} Only… *four* in the morning. {sweat} [surprised, shrug, whisper]
Peddy: FOUR?! {facepalm} We read *zero* pages! [angry, hips, shout, fail]
Teddy: {ohoo} Don't worry. {idea} I have a *genius* plan! [suspicious, think, ding]
# Scene: classroom (sitting, books)
Peddy: {hmm} So what is your *plan*? [suspicious, hips, whisper]
Teddy: {nod} I prayed the exam gets *cancelled*! [happy, wave, excited]
Peddy: {oops} Teddy… today is *Sunday*. [surprised, shrug, calm]
Teddy: {yay} No exam! {dance} Time to *sleep*! {sleep} [happy, wave, excited, applause]
